sentences.text: FDA's records show epinephrine is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the prior shortage first posted 2012-04-27 is resolved.
An import alert 66-66 was published 2009-09-30 for Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG (FEI 3002806556), 940 days before the 2012-04-27 shortage posting.
FDA inspection 808119 at that Boehringer Ingelheim plant ended 2012-11-12 and was classified OAI, 199 days after the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued 2013-05-06 to the same Boehringer Ingelheim plant, 374 days after the shortage posting.
FDA inspection 762138 at Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) ended 2012-01-04 classified VAI, 114 days before the shortage posting.
Later FDA inspection 1064827 at Hospira ended 2018-08-15 classified OAI, with the OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 2917 days after the shortage posting.
The best option by rule is to buy from Viatris Specialty LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
